description: Author-declared line accepted by the host (step 20j-2, B128): the same program as declare-refund, run with --release-on-declared. The first conversation is a clear no (0.08, ignore); the second reads above the declared line (0.85 >= 0.7, act), so the irreversible write_json runs. Without the switch the same act exit would stop at J-08.
